name: TestimonialCard - Every Field Filled
description: The card doing its whole job: event photo with its navy caption bar on the left, and on the right the quote under a crimson rule with a gold-ringed portrait above an affiliation and a role. The ceiling to the sibling scenario's floor — almost every field on this component is optional, so a frame of only the degenerate state would misrepresent it. Between the two they bracket every optional the card carries.
